sources.title: Adobe Substance 3D Painter - product & pricing page

keyLimits.en: Bundles Painter, Designer, Sampler and Stager, 20,000+ 3D assets, and 100GB cloud storage. Painter is not sold as a lower-priced standalone plan on this page.
Per-license price; annual commitment billed monthly. Adds 1TB cloud storage and business-only capabilities.
Free full app access with community assets and 5GB cloud storage, restricted to personal/non-commercial use.

cautions.en: Painter is not offered as a standalone single-app plan on the official page seen during this pass; the entry price to use it commercially is the full Collection bundle at $59.99/mo, not a cheaper Painter-only tier that the earlier seed data (24.99$/mo) implied.

capabilities.en: Real-time PBR texture painting engine with smart masks and materials that mimic real-world surface behavior.
Non-destructive editing: every stroke and action is recorded and can be recomputed at any time.
Automatic UV generation and support for VFX pipelines (UDIMs, Alembic, Python scripting).
Exports to major renderers and game engines, with compatibility for .fbx, .obj, .abc, .gltf and .usd formats.

limitations.en: No standalone lower-cost Painter-only plan visible on the official page; commercial access requires the full Substance 3D Collection subscription.
No permanent free tier for commercial use; the free option is restricted to students/teachers for personal, non-commercial work.

reason.en: Sibling Adobe tool focused on procedural material authoring rather than direct mesh painting, often used alongside or instead of Painter.

missingAlternatives.name: Mari (Foundry)
missingAlternatives.reason: High-end VFX/film-industry texture-painting competitor to Substance 3D Painter, not present in the catalogue.

missingAlternatives.name: Blender (texture paint)
missingAlternatives.reason: Free, open-source alternative offering basic PBR texture painting, commonly cited as a no-cost entry point versus Painter; absent from the candidate list.

unknowns: Whether a lower-priced Painter-only subscription still exists outside the Collection bundle was not confirmed; the seed data's $24.99/mo 'Texturing plan' figure could not be verified on the current official page and may be outdated.
Linux support/compatibility was not confirmed on the official page.
conflicts: Seed pricingText mentioned a 'Texturing' plan at $24.99/mo and a 'Collection' plan at $59.99/mo; the official page fetched during this pass only surfaced the Collection (individual/teams) and Students & Teachers plans, with no visible standalone Texturing tier.
